items.lede: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.
items.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you

items.lede: Images are generated with OpenAI's latest model and you can save clothes you like for later.
items.title: ChatGPT can now help you virtually try on clothes
